title: Sunseeker Manhattan 68
highlights: Aft beach club behind a hydraulic door
Gulf Edition saloon with 55" TV on a rise-and-fall platform
Flybridge hard top with opening centre section and electric sun canopy
Joystick docking system and camera monitoring
Sonos zoned audio across cockpit, flybridge and foredeck
Platinum Mediterranean package with tropical A/C
description:
The 2025 Sunseeker Manhattan 68 is built for effortless entertaining, with large sunbathing areas, a well-equipped wet bar and an aft beach club usually found on larger yachts.

She offers 4 guest cabins for 8 guests, plus a crew cabin for 2. The master has an island berth, walk-in wardrobe, seating area and en-suite; the VIP and twin cabins have their own bathrooms. The Gulf Edition saloon has opposing sofas, an extending table and a 55" TV on a rise-and-fall platform.

Twin MAN V8 1200 engines give a top speed of 32 knots. Her equipment includes a hard top with opening centre section and electric sun canopy, a joystick docking system, camera monitoring, Sonos zoned audio and the Platinum Mediterranean package.

Located in Dubai. Contact us for the full specification and a private viewing.
